stories.title: PM Carney confirms four service members died and dozens were wounded in the CFB Wainwright fire
stories.reason: A preliminary investigation suggests a munition from a live-fire training exercise sparked the blaze, which spread rapidly beyond the training area's boundaries, with National Defence saying there is no indication of a terrorist attack as the incident remains under investigation.

stories.title: The historic Limoges town hall collapses in flames as French cost-of-living protests turn violent nationwide
stories.reason: Masked individuals torched the 143-year-old landmark after a 550,000-strong nationwide demonstration, collapsing its 43-meter clock tower, as French officials condemned the attack and nearly 1,800 people were arrested with over 500 police officers injured across the country.

stories.title: Israeli settlers attack a European diplomatic convoy and beat a French mayor with iron bars in the West Bank
stories.reason: Masked settlers surrounded and stoned vehicles carrying Belgian, French, Polish and Catholic representatives near Taybeh, injuring 78-year-old Mayor Bernard Baudoux, as Netanyahu's office called the widely filmed attack merely 'alleged' despite published footage.

stories.title: Trump publicly endorses Netanyahu nine days before Israel's election, an unprecedented move by a sitting US president
stories.reason: Trump called Netanyahu a 'Great Warrior' and tied the endorsement to Iran policy, warning he won't 'finish the job' against Tehran if Israel elects 'the wrong leader,' even as most polls show Netanyahu's coalition falling short of a governing majority.

stories.title: Anthropic quietly pitches US lawmakers a draft bill narrowly limiting government power to block AI models
stories.reason: The proposal would let only a federal judge halt a frontier model, and only over risks of $1 billion in damages or 50+ deaths from bioweapons, control evasion or cyberattacks, while explicitly barring any other federal agency from suspending AI development or deployment.

stories.title: OpenAI confirms it is building a humanoid robot, with Altman targeting a demo in 2027
stories.reason: Altman said the robot's physical body matters less than the AI controlling it and that street-walking robots remain years away, as the company's careers page now lists 27 open robotics positions.

stories.title: Chip stocks post their longest losing streak since 2008 even as Nvidia's Huang insists the rout 'will pass'
stories.reason: The semiconductor index has fallen for eight straight sessions and shed roughly $2 trillion in market value since October 6, driven by debt-financing worries around AI cloud firms like CoreWeave rather than any sign of weakening chip demand.

stories.title: A Financial Times investigation finds at least 47 major US data center projects delayed, withdrawn or blocked in 2026
stories.reason: Bernstein analysts cited in the report judge only about 35% of the planned US data center pipeline credible, while a separate tracker found 45 projects worth nearly $68 billion disrupted by local opposition in just the second quarter alone.
